editorial:
You meet Tom Cutler, a quiet single dad who used to be a cop and now makes a living cleaning up after violent deaths. When he gets a job at a rich suburban house, he scrubs away blood and mess without realizing he may be wiping away proof of a murder. That mistake pulls him into a cover-up involving powerful people, and you watch him try to fix it while protecting his daughter. The movie has a dark, serious mood, but it stays easy to follow and keeps you guessing about who is lying.

Samuel L. Jackson gives a strong, grounded performance, and the story moves at a steady pace with enough twists to keep you interested. Some scenes feel a little predictable, and the ending may not satisfy everyone, but the tension and mystery make it a solid watch. If you like crime thrillers about ordinary people caught in bad situations, this is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Tom realizes the cleanup was tied to a bigger cover-up and that people close to the case are not who they seem. He uses his knowledge of crime scenes and old police instincts to confront the truth, clear his name, and protect his daughter. The twist reveals the real killer and the reason the evidence was erased, leaving Tom with a hard choice but a chance to do the right thing.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with twists and moral dilemmas.
